## Checklist

- [ ] I added or updated behavior-focused tests when observable behavior changed.
- [ ] I updated user documentation when a command, option, schema, or output changed.
- [ ] I did not include private prose, customer data, secrets, or unlicensed third-party content.
- [ ] I preserved benchmark inputs and provenance, or I clearly identified an intentional benchmark change.
